newsitem.title: EU: Official Journal contents - OJ L 225 of August 15, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Official Journal contents - OJ L 225 of August 15, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)
COMMISSION DECISION of 14 July 1997 concerning the placing on the market of T102-test (Streptococcus thermophilus T102) pursuant to Council Directive 90/220/EEC (Text with EEA relevance) (97/549/EC)

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1629/97 of 14 August 1997 fixing the refunds applicable to cereal and rice sector products supplied as Community and national food aid
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1628/97 of 14 August 1997 fixing the import duties in the cereals sector
